_comment: Canary values of the channel check (CRD-06, COL-02, WP-899): unique strings the test stores as secrets. None may leave the server through an API answer, a log line, an audit, change or event entry, a notice, a usage row, a job result, a NATS message or the metrics; the sealed bundle of a collector never holds the value of a server reference. A find names the canary, never its value.
